pre_execution_questions.question: How to validate domain and pinned references without reopening intake paths?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Use bounded decoded snapshot bytes and pure validate_documents/reference checks; accepted history comes from immutable retained rows under writer lock. Never call validate_package filesystem I/O as secure boundary. Validate object/envelope IDs/type/schema/provenance and every required numeric text limit.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to classify a timeout or unknown COMMIT outcome?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Keep UNKNOWN/retryable status until reopen/recovery and exact transaction/hash lookup establishes zero or one retained commit; never infer failure/success from exception alone or replace producer IDs.

acceptance_checks.check: New private synthetic DB only; verify candidate physical v1 tables/constraints/headers, SQLite>=3.37, DELETE/EXTRA, foreign_keys=ON, trusted_schema=OFF and supported defensive configuration. Unknown existing format rejected without initialization/mutation; interrupted new initialization not accepted.

Consume only live verified snapshot bytes, no original-path reopen. Whole-command schema/type/object-envelope/provenance/pinned-reference and numeric-policy validation. Continuation resolves against retained accepted history; unsupported type/schema/missing or wrong-object revision rejects without canonical changes.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes exact-ID/hash replay lookup before CAS; exact replay after later head changes returns original commit/revisions, changed transaction hash and reused revision ID conflict. Type/base ownership/current-head and multi-object stale-base conflicts rollback whole command. Busy is bounded retryable, never conflict/accepted.

One SQLite transaction retains exact READY/manifest/policy/original BLOB bytes, all revisions and original ACCEPTED receipt with app-generated attempt/commit IDs/sequence. Bounded BLOB streaming/hash verification, handles closed before commit; no partial success or replacement of previous canonical receipts by failed attempts. Receipt schemas/fields verified.

Inject owned copy/BLOB/I-O/ENOSPC failures and terminate only owned children before/after commit and before receipt return. Reopen establishes zero or one canonical commit; retain receipt/original bytes or report integrity error; never delete rollback journals manually. Test bounded lock budget/unknown outcome and exact safe retry.

Read-only receipt/original recovery from DB after source changes/removal; byte/hash identity, immutable history and head derivation. Multi-object acceptance/replay/conflict and parent-child reference cases use real supported R1 fixtures. Do not conflate transport-only success with ACCEPTED/REPLAY.

Record native SQLite/Python/configuration, per-case expected/actual outcomes, issue open/resolved history, source/baseline/readback guards and precise scope. Mandatory unavailable cases NOT_VERIFIED block completion; no live Bank/UI/hardware power-off/production or R0/R1 gate acceptance.
